name: Oak Golem
description: Oak Golems are made from oak wood. They are humanoid, with a short and stocky form.

entries: └Golden Cat's Eye Rivet (Small) (200) (►Twin Strike & Double Attack)
Jet Sign (Small) (100) (🗨Aimed Attack = +2 Accuracy and -4 damage)
Garnet of Vitality (Small) (200) (◯HP Enhancement = Max HP +5)

name: Oak Hound
description: This quadrupedal golem is made of oak wood and, like the Oak Golem, is not very precisely sculpted.

entries: Garnet of Vitality (Small) (200) (◯HP Enhancement = Max HP +5)

name: Straw Bird

skills.name: Fire Vulnerability
text: When Straw Bird is hit by Fire-type damage, it takes an extra 3 damage.

skills.name: Flight
text: A Straw Bird receives a +1 bonus to Accuracy and Evasion only for melee
attacks.

description: This lightweight bird-shaped golem is made of woven grass stalks.

entries:
Amethyst of Purple Lightning (Small) (600)
►Discharge/4(11)/Willpower/Half
Golem unleashes an electrical bolt with “Range/Area: 2(20m)/Shot”, dealing 2d+3 lightning magic damage. Stray shots cannot occur with this ability.
Garnet of Vitality (Small) (200) (◯HP Enhancement = Max HP +5)
Moonstone of Serenity (Small) (250) (Remove [○Fire Vulnerability], and Weak Point "None").

name: Loam Puppet

skills.name: Mud Body
text: Blunt weapons treat the Loam Puppet's Defense as 5 points higher.
In addition, a Loam Puppet is immune to criticals from edged weapons.

description: A golem made from clay is the hopes and desires of its creator-given form. Typically standing around 1m, a Loam Puppet is often humanoid, though it can be any shape the creator wishes. Also, the shape does not make any difference in performance.

entries: └Golden Cat's Eye Rivet (Small) (200) (►Twin Strike & Double Attack)
Garnet of Vitality (Small) (200) (◯HP Enhancement = Max HP +5)

name: Bone Animal

skills.name: Bone Body
text: Bone Animal is immune to criticals from edged weapons.

description: It is a golem made from the bones of an animal, and all that remains is the skeleton of the original animal.

entries: Garnet of Vitality (Small) (200) (◯HP Enhancement = Max HP +5)

name: Leather Fish

skills.name: Underwater
text: Leather Fish doesn't receive penalties for moving or taking action in the
water. However, it can't perform any Action without water.

description: This fish-shaped golem is made from animal skin. It does not have scales and has a slimy texture.

entries:
Blue Lotus Jade (Small) (600)
►Water Gun/5 (12)/Fortitude/Half
Golem sprays a jet of water with “Range/Area: 2(20m)/Shot” onto “Target: 1 Character”, dealing 2d+4 water/ice magic damage and causing it to fall prone. Stray shots cannot occur with this ability.
Garnet of Vitality (Small) (200) (◯HP Enhancement = Max HP +5)

name: Flabby Golem
description: It is a golem made of flesh. It is about 2 to 3 meters in size and looks like a simplified version of the human form.

entries: └Golden Cat's Eye Rivet (Small) (200) (►Twin Strike & Double Attack)
Garnet of Vitality (Small) (200) (◯HP Enhancement = Max HP +5)
└Focused Garnet of Vitality (Small) (300) (◯Improved HP Enhancement = Max HP +5)

name: Stone Servant

skills.name: Stone Body
text: A Stone Servant is immune to criticals from both edged weapons and all
non-Energy-type Magic damage.

description: A golem made of stone, this golem is about 2 meters in size, and as long as it has arms and legs, its shape can be freely set by the creator, but it cannot be made very precise, nor can its color or texture be changed. Also, the shape does not make a difference game-wise.

entries: └Golden Cat's Eye Rivet (Medium) (800) (►Twin Strike & Double Attack)
Jet Sign (Medium) (400) (🗨Aimed Attack = +2 Accuracy and -4 damage)
Garnet of Vitality (Medium) (800) (◯HP Enhancement = Max HP +10)
└Focused Garnet of Vitality (Medium) (1,200) (◯Improved HP Enhancement = Max HP +10)

name: Brasswing

skills.name: Brass Body
text: A Brasswing is immune to criticals from edged weapons and all magic
damage, except for Energy-type damage.

skills.name: Flight
text: A Brasswing receives a +1 bonus to Accuracy and Evasion only for melee
attacks.

description: This bird-shaped golem is made by layering thin sheets of brass.

entries:
Bright Red Ruby (Medium) (1,600)
►Flame Breath/8(15)/Fortitude/Half
Golem spits out the fire with "Range/Area: 2(20m)/Shot" and “Target: 1 area (3m Radius)/5,” dealing 2d+6 fire magic damage. This ability cannot be used on consecutive turns. It also cannot be used on the turn immediately after using [►Lightning].

Amethyst of Purple Lightning (Medium) (1,600)
►Lightning/8(15)/Fortitude/Half
Golem unleashes an electrical bolt with "Range/Area: 30m/Line", dealing 2d+6 lightning magic damage to the target. This ability cannot be used on consecutive turns. It also cannot be used on the turn immediately after using [►Flame Breath].
Garnet of Vitality (Medium) (800) (◯HP Enhancement = Max HP +10)

skills.name: Stone Body

non-Energy-type Magic damage.

skills.name: Underwater

description: It is a fish-shaped golem made of light, perforated rock.

entries:

Garnet of Vitality (Medium) (800) (◯HP Enhancement = Max HP +10)

name: Granite Shell

skills.name: Rock Body
text: A Granite Shell is immune to criticals from edged weapons and all magic
damage, except Energy-type damage.

skills.name: Underwater Specialization
text: Can move in water without penalties and restrictions. Conversely, all
action checks are subject to a -2 penalty on the ground.

skills.name: Shell Guard
text: The Granite Shell can retract into its shell, increasing its Defense by +10
for 10 seconds (1 round).

description: It is a large golem in the shape of a sea turtle with a granite shell.

entries:

└Focused Garnet of Vitality (Large) (6,000) (◯Improved HP Enhancement = Max HP +15)

sectionsNote: Sections: 3 (Body / Wing x 2) Main Section: None

skills.name: Superalloy Body

skills.name: Flight II

skills.name: Frog’s Body
text: The frog can move underwater. Its mobility is equal to that of a normal
frog.

skills.name: Spider’s Body
text: The spider can move freely on walls and ceilings. While sticking to the
ceiling, it will not target a wide range of effects unless the enemy specifically
target’s familiar. Its mobility is equal to a recluse spider.

skills.name: Bird's Body
text: Capable of flight. Physical ability is that of a normal bird.

skills.name: Flight
text: A Bird Familiar receives a +1 bonus to Accuracy and Evasion only for
melee attacks.

skills.name: Cat's Body
text: Can pass through narrow gaps, etc. Physical ability is the same as an
ordinary housecat.

skills.name: Gives Darkvision
text: Shares its Darkvision with the Master.

skills.name: Snake's Body
text: The snake can pass through extremely narrow spaces. Its physical ability
is equal to that of the normal snake.

skills.name: Toxic Tooth
text: When a familiar makes a melee attack and hits, it automatically deals 1
poison magic damage to the target of the melee attack. This ability only
works if the familiar is in touch range with the Master.
